subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 2: CLIL Science – Think like a scientist!
outcomes: Say what an explanation is and when we use it.
Plan an explanation with cause-and-effect arrows.
Explain causes and effects of climate change.

tf.s: An explanation tells us how or why something happens.
tf.why: Yes, explanations answer how and why.

tf.s: Explanations tell us when and where something happens.
tf.why: They tell us how or why something happens.

tf.s: In our notes, arrows link a cause to its effect.
tf.why: Correct, the arrow points from cause to effect.
Right, car gases pollute the air.

tf.s: Global warming causes the cutting down of forests.
tf.why: It is the other way: cutting down forests causes global warming.

tf.s: Using fossil fuels causes global warming.
tf.why: Well done, burning fossil fuels warms the planet.

tf.s: A cause is what happens as a result.
tf.why: A cause makes something happen; the result is the effect.

tf.s: We can use 'because of', 'due to' and 'so' to explain causes and effects.
tf.why: Yes, these words link causes and effects.

tf.s: Cutting down forests is one cause of global warming.
tf.why: Correct, it is a cause in the lesson.

tf.s: An effect is the reason why something happens.
tf.why: The reason is the cause; the effect is the result.

boxes.q: What does an explanation tell us?
What do arrows show in our notes?
boxes.why: Arrows join a cause to its effect.
Burning fossil fuels causes global warming.

boxes.q: In 'cutting down forests → global warming', what is the effect?
boxes.why: The effect comes after the arrow.

boxes.q: Which word joins a cause to an effect?

o: the thing that makes something happen

boxes.why: An effect is what happens because of a cause.

boxes.q: Which is a cause of air pollution?
Complete: Using fossil fuels ___ global warming.
boxes.why: Using fossil fuels causes global warming.

o: a text that tells how or why something happens

mcq.q: What do arrows show in cause-and-effect notes?
o: a cause leading to an effect

mcq.q: Which of these causes global warming?
mcq.why: Cutting down forests causes global warming.

mcq.q: Which word means the result of a cause?
Turn the notes into a sentence: fossil fuels → global warming.
o: Using fossil fuels causes global warming.
Fossil fuels and global warming are friends.

mcq.q: Complete: ___ air pollution, many people have breathing problems.

o: Using fossil fuels causes global warming, so our planet gets hotter.
Our planet gets hotter, so we use fossil fuels to cool it.

mcq.q: 'Global warming causes the cutting down of forests.' What is wrong?
o: The cause and effect are the wrong way round.
It should be about the Moon.
mcq.why: Cutting down forests causes global warming.

mcq.q: In 'gases from cars → air pollution → global warming', what is air pollution?
o: an effect of car gases and a cause of global warming
mcq.why: One thing can be both an effect and a cause in a chain.

mcq.q: Which question does an explanation answer?
o: Why is the planet getting hotter?
mcq.why: Explanations answer why or how questions.
